usage.unknownFlag.message: Unknown flag: --bogus. See --help for supported options.
usage.unknownFlag.recovery: Correct the command arguments and try again.

usage.missingToolArgument.recovery: Pass a public Tool slug or a supported namespace:value key.

usage.invalidLimit.message: Search result limit must be between 1 and 50 (observed 51).
usage.invalidLimit.recovery: Use a whole-number result limit between 1 and 50.

runtime.notFound.recovery: Run slothhub search <query> to find a valid slug.

runtime.transport.message: Unable to load feed /api/index.json from https://slothhub.dev.
runtime.transport.recovery: Check that https://slothhub.dev is reachable, or point the CLI at another SlothHub origin with --base-url <origin> or SLOTHHUB_BASE_URL, then try again.

runtime.hostBlocked.message: HTTP 403: request blocked by the host's traffic protection (x-vercel-mitigated: challenge)
runtime.hostBlocked.recovery: SlothHub's host blocked this automated request, usually after a burst of requests from the same network. Wait a few minutes, then retry with fewer parallel sessions. A CLI or MCP client cannot complete a browser challenge.

runtime.unsupportedVersion.message: Feed version 99.0.0 is unsupported; this client supports 33.x. Upgrade the client, then retry.
runtime.unsupportedVersion.recovery: Upgrade the CLI with npm install -g @slothhub/cli@latest, then retry.

runtime.unsupportedNode.recovery: Run slothhub on a supported Node.js version and retry.
